steps: Client assigns key K to one logical command and preserves it on retry.
Server atomically claims K and records request fingerprint.
Business effect and completion state commit under that claim.
A retry finds K and returns the stored result without repeating the effect.

lesson.scenario: A payment API returns the original charge result when a client retries after losing the response.

steps.title: Claim the logical command
steps.narration: The API hashes canonical payload amount=4900,currency=USD,order=O-90017 to sha256:a771.

steps.outcome: Retries can be distinguished from key misuse.
steps.invariant: The key is scoped, payload-bound, durably claimed before side effects, and completed with the exact response returned to every retry.

steps.title: Create the unique key row
steps.narration: A unique constraint on tenant and key elects this request as owner and stores fingerprint a771.

steps.outcome: Only one request may perform the side effect.
steps.invariant: The key is scoped, payload-bound, durably claimed before side effects, and completed with the exact response returned to every retry.

steps.title: Commit the external charge
steps.narration: The processor creates charge ch_8821 once using the same idempotency key.
steps.outcome: The external side effect has a stable identity.
steps.invariant: The key is scoped, payload-bound, durably claimed before side effects, and completed with the exact response returned to every retry.

steps.title: Store the authoritative response
steps.narration: The ledger and idempotency result record commit status 201, charge ch_8821, and response checksum 3c91 before reply.
steps.invariant: The key is scoped, payload-bound, durably claimed before side effects, and completed with the exact response returned to every retry.

steps.title: Replay after response loss
steps.narration: Attempt two finds the completed row, verifies fingerprint a771, and returns the original 201 body without contacting the processor.
steps.outcome: One logical command produces one charge.
steps.invariant: The key is scoped, payload-bound, durably claimed before side effects, and completed with the exact response returned to every retry.
